---
title: "Olympic data cleaning"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

olympics <- read_csv("athlete_events.csv")

oly19 <- olympics |> filter(Year >= 1900) |> group_by(Year) |> mutate(Participants = n()) |> ungroup()

olympicsF <- oly19 |> filter (Sex == "F") |> select(ID, Name, Age, Height, Weight, Team, NOC, Games, Year, Season, City, Sport, Event, Medal, Participants)

write_csv(olympicsF, "female_olympics.csv")

olympicsF <- olympics |> filter (Sex == "F")
olympicsF <- olympicsF |> filter(Year >= 1900)



olympicsM <- olympics |> filter (Sex == "M")
```

```{r}
particpation <- olympics |> group_by(Games, Sex) |> mutate(n_Participants = n()) |> slice(1)

particpation <- particpation |> mutate(Year = as.factor(Year))

particpation <- particpation |> mutate(Year = fct_inseq(Year))

ggplot(particpation, aes(x = Year, y = n_Participants)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Sex)) +
  facet_wrap(~Season)
```
